top_findings.title: All 4 tests fail: 'async def functions are not natively supported'
top_findings.evidence: tests/test_api.py:5,12,27,46 use @pytest.mark.asyncio but pytest-asyncio is not installed/declared. Reproduced pytest --cov=. run: '4 failed, 10 warnings' with 'PytestUnknownMarkWarning: Unknown pytest.mark.asyncio' and 'Failed: async def functions are not natively supported'. The .coverage numbits confirm only def/decorator lines ran — no test body executed. TOTAL coverage 33% (import-only) == scores.json test_coverage=0.33.
top_findings.suggestion: Declare pytest-asyncio (and fastapi/httpx) in requirements.txt and add asyncio_mode=auto (or a pytest.ini) so the async test bodies actually run — or rewrite tests with fastapi.testclient.TestClient (sync).

top_findings.title: R12 '>=3 tests run and pass' unmet — 4 tests exist, 0 pass
top_findings.evidence: tests/test_api.py defines 4 async tests; a reproduced `python -m pytest --cov=.` run reports '4 failed' (0 passed). scores.json test_coverage=0.33 is line-coverage%, parsed from the TOTAL line by _parse_coverage(), NOT a pass rate — it reflects import-only coverage. This is a REPAIR task; FEEDBACK.md explicitly flagged '4 tests exist but none pass' and it was not fixed.
top_findings.suggestion: Fix the async test harness (pytest-asyncio + asyncio_mode) so >=3 tests actually run and pass.
